name: showreel-s01-contrast

voice.text: Why does your grey text vanish on phones? That grey scores about two to one. Text needs four and a half. The fix: hash seven six seven six seven six, or darker. Now every price reads at a glance.

caption:
Why does your grey text vanish on phones? 👀

Light grey text on white looks calm in the mockup, but #b3b3b3 on white has a contrast ratio of about 2.1 to 1, and on a phone in daylight it all but disappears. WCAG asks for at least 4.5 to 1 for body text (3 to 1 for large text). On white, #767676 is the lightest grey that passes (4.54 to 1); anything darker passes too. Check your prices, captions and placeholders.
Save it for your next design review, or send it to whoever picked the grey.

sources.note: MDN Color contrast (WCAG 1.4.3, AA): text and its background at least 4.5:1; large text (18pt, or 14pt bold) at least 3:1; AAA 7:1
WCAG 2.2 contrast ratio (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05) with relative luminance; computed: #b3b3b3 on #fff = 2.10:1, #767676 on #fff = 4.54:1

tip.title: Why does your grey text vanish on phones?
tip.why: Light grey on white looks soft in a mockup, but #b3b3b3 on white is about 2.1:1, and on a phone in daylight it washes out. WCAG asks for at least 4.5:1 for body text (MDN). On white, #767676 is the lightest grey that passes (4.54:1).
